description: Post-1.0 Phase 25 — cloud save production cutover. Env keys, Identity Toolkit anonymous auth + refresh recovery, Phase 11 conflict UI, and offline push queue (last snapshot wins). Finish 2.0 Phase 26 ships a reviewed rules snippet only (not a deployable firestore.rules).

web.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
web.description: Firebase Web API key for Identity Toolkit + Firestore REST

guestRecovery.note: Anonymous uid restored via Secure Token refresh_token grant

offlineQueue.note: Failed cloud.push enqueues the latest encoded snapshot; flush clears on successful put.

cutoverChecklist: Set web VITE_FIREBASE_* and Android fish.firebase.* from Firebase console
Confirm Identity Toolkit Anonymous sign-in enabled
Confirm Firestore database (default) exists in the project
Paste shared/cloud/snippets/firestore-harbor-save.rules into Firebase Console (snippet-only; no auto-deploy)
Enable cloud sync in Settings; grant guest; verify conflict UI with two devices
Toggle airplane mode, checkpoint, restore network — offline queue flushes
Run npm run firestoreqa:validate (Finish 2.0 Phase 26 conflict/offline QA harness)
